# Raasi Palace

> A fully air-conditioned, vegetarian-only wedding hall for 600 to 1,800 guests, opposite Metro Pillar 586.

Website: https://raasi.co.in/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 79049 05681

## Contact

## Key facts
- 1,800 guests at most, from 600
- 175 seats in the dining hall
- 8 air-conditioned rooms
- 65 cars parked, plus 200 bikes

## Facilities
- Fully air-conditioned
- 100% generator backup
- Lift
- Vegetarian only
- Catering
- Nadaswaram & DJ
- Photography
- Stage decoration
- Serial lights

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can Raasi Palace hold?
Raasi Palace hosts 600 to 1,800 guests, with 175 seats in the dining hall.

### Where is Raasi Palace?
41/9, Medavakkam Main Road, Ganesh Nagar, Madipakkam, Chennai 600 091 (Opposite Metro Pillar 586, near A2B Keelkattalai).

### What facilities does Raasi Palace have?
Fully air-conditioned, 100% generator backup, Lift, Vegetarian only, Catering, Nadaswaram & DJ, Photography, Stage decoration, Serial lights.

### Is the food vegetarian?
Yes. Raasi Palace is vegetarian only, with catering arranged by the hall.

### Is there parking?
Yes, parking for 65 cars and 200 bikes.

### How do I check if Raasi Palace is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 79049 05681.
